# Screens

122 screens, every one captured from the running framework by [`tools/screenshots.py`](../tools/screenshots.py) in offline mode. Nothing here is a mock-up or an image file: products, charts, maps and illustrations are drawn by components, and each screen is a function of a few dozen lines that you can read, run and change.

| Kind | Screens | Open it yourself |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [Landing pages](#landing-pages) | 14 | `./fluidian showcase` |
| [Storefronts](#storefronts) | 12 | `./fluidian showcase` |
| [Dashboards](#dashboards) | 16 | `./fluidian showcase` |
| [AI products](#ai-products) | 13 | `./fluidian showcase` |
| [Mobile and cross-platform](#mobile-and-cross-platform) | 14 | `./fluidian showcase` |
| [Application modules](#application-modules) | 16 | `./fluidian showcase` |
| [Gallery](#gallery) | 37 | `./fluidian gallery` |

The showcase screens live in [`examples/showcase`](../examples/showcase); the gallery is [`examples/gallery/app.py`](../examples/gallery/app.py). Brands and people in these screens are fictional.
